resourceCorrelation.note: guest CPU/RAM/disk sampled in-guest at 100ms while LabVIEW launched, folded onto the host epoch (offset via min-RTT) and split at the UI-READY settle trigger (pre=launching / post=settled)

coldTrend.runner: live-vbox-labview-launch.mjs per run; VBoxManage controlvm <vm> reset between runs (cold page cache)
coldTrend.method: hard-reset the VM, wait for fresh gdm boot, re-set runtime VNC pw, capture the FIRST launch (cold)

warmVsCold.note: cold (page-cache-cleared, first launch after reboot) is markedly slower AND noisier than warm; the delta is the OS-page-cache cost of reading LabVIEW off disk
